SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
H. Q. C. B. Station, 299/17
Date Aug. 5, 1938.

REPORT

Subject FURTHER TO ASSISTANCE TO JAPANESE MILITARY POLICE.

Made by D.S.I. PRYDE Forwarded by D. I. GLOVER.

Sir,

Both the arrested persons namely:-

KOO MING TS (顾明佐) &
KOO MING HAU (顾明浩)

were released at 12 noon on 4.8.38 against shop guarantees,
as the Japanese Military Police stated they did not require
the detention of these two men any further.

Both men had been finger printed and neither have any
previous conviction.

(批：M.C.9
5/8/38)

(印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE SPECIAL BRANCH)

I am, Sir,

Yours obediently,

(签名)
D. S. I.

C96
Regt)

报告

事由：关于进一步协助日本宪兵队事宜。

由副督察长 PRYDE 呈报，经督察长 GLOVER 转呈。

先生：

两名被捕人员，即：

顾明佐 (KOO MING TS) 及
顾明浩 (KOO MING HAU)

已于1938年8月4日中午12时凭店铺保释获释，
因日本宪兵队表示不再需要拘留此二人。

此二人均已采集指纹，且均无前科记录。

REPORT

Subject FURTHER TO ASSISTANCE TO JAPANESE MILITARY POLICE.

Made by D.S.I. PRYDE Forwarded by I. GROVER.

Sir,

Statements have been taken from the two arrested persons who are still detained. Copies of statements attached.

Regarding the query of the D.C. (CRIME) on the previous report "What is evidence based on"?

At the time assistance was requested it was understood from D.S. Mitsushima that the Japanese Military Police had prisoners in custody who implicated the wanted man, Loh Kuh Ming, in terrorist acts committed on 7.7.38. Also Sgt. Major Katoda was in possession of a photograph of Loh Kuh Ming.

When, however, the application to search the Carter Road Post Office was made on 2.8.38 and this was queried by the D.C. (CRIME), Sgt. Major Katoda was questioned regarding his evidence by D.I. Glover and the undersigned and he stated that no persons had been arrested, but the Military Police were in receipt of information that Loh Kuh Ming was concerned in the assassination of Tseu Liu Wu (周柳五) in the Oriental Hotel (4.7.38).

It was first understood from Sgt. Major Katoda through the interpretation of D.S. Mitsushima:-

1. That Loh Kuh Ming was employed i/c of delivery postmen at Carter Road Post Office.
2. That Loh Kuh Ming had been transferred to Canton.
3. That Loh Kuh Ming had not yet actually left for Canton but was somewhere in Shanghai awaiting transfer to Canton.

日期：1938年8月3日。

报告

事由：关于进一步协助日本宪兵队事宜。

由副督察长 PRYDE 呈报，经督察长 GROVER 转呈。

先生：

已对两名仍在羁押中的被捕人员取得供词。供词副本附后。

关于刑事处副处长在前一份报告中提出的疑问：“依据何种证据？”

在请求协助时，从三岛警部补（D.S. Mitsushima）处获悉，日本宪兵队拘押的囚犯中有人牵连到通缉犯陆克明（Loh Kuh Ming），指其参与了1938年7月7日实施的恐怖活动。此外，加藤军曹长（Sgt. Major Katoda）持有陆克明的照片。

然而，当于1938年8月2日提出搜查康纳路（Carter Road）邮局的申请，且刑事处副处长对此提出质疑时，督察长 Glover 和本人讯问了加藤军曹长关于其证据的情况，他陈述称并未逮捕任何人，但宪兵队收到情报称陆克明牵涉到1938年7月4日在东方饭店刺杀周柳五（Tseu Liu Wu）一案。

最初通过三岛警部补的翻译，从加藤军曹长处获悉：

1. 陆克明受雇于康纳路邮局，负责管理投递信差。
2. 陆克明已被调往广州。
3. 陆克明尚未实际启程前往广州，而是身处上海某地等待调令。

曾向加藤军曹长建议，如果邮局当局知晓陆克明

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
REPORT OF POLICE INVESTIGATIONS.

The following is the statement of KOO MING SZ (顾明滋), 23,
native of Woosung, taken by me D.S.I. Soong
at C.I. on the 2.6.38 and interpreted by Clerk Yao

My name is Koo Ming Sz, aged 23 years, native of Woosung,
M/Proprietor - Dry Goods Store, Nantao, residing at House 5,
Lane 199, Chunick Road.

Prior to the outbreak of hostilities, I used to be part
owner of a dry-goods store in Nantao, as well as proprietor of
the Kai Tai Fish Hong in Woosung.

During August, last, hostilities broke out, and we moved
to Shanghai, putting up at the above address, the home of Loh
Kuh Ming, after our efforts to seek a suitable house to
accommodate us failed. We were altogether seven persons living
at Loh's place.

Loh was seldom at home and he used to have numerous
friends call at his house.

Sometime in January, 1938, Loh informed us that he intended
to move into the Concession. He was then requested to allow us
to continue the lease of the premises, which he agreed. Following
that, he and his wife moved out, taking with them everything that
was not very heavy and clumsy and used only some rickshas for
transportation. His furniture has been left behind since.

Loh is related to us by marriage. He is a native of
Soochow, aged about 30 years, and was formerly with the Chinese
Post Office, receiving about $70 or $80 per month.

After his removal, visitors called and enquired as his
whereabouts. Telephone messages were also received with similar
queries. We do not know his exact address, except the fact that
he is living somewhere in French Town. This is the truth.

Signed : KOO MING SZ ( )

警务调查报告。

以下为顾明滋（KOO MING SZ），23岁，吴淞人，由本人副督察长宋（Soong）于1938年6月2日在刑事调查科讯问，并由姚职员翻译的供词：

我叫顾明滋，现年23岁，吴淞人，职业为南市干货店店主，居住于春熙路199弄5号。

在战事爆发前，我曾是南市一家干货店的合伙人，同时也是吴淞凯泰鱼行的老板。

去年八月战事爆发后，我们搬至上海，因未能找到合适的住所，便借住在上述地址，即陆克明的家中。当时共有七人居住在陆克明处。

陆克明很少在家，常有众多朋友来访。

1938年1月某时，陆克明告知我们他打算搬入租界。我们随即请求他允许我们继续租赁该房屋，他同意了。随后，他和妻子搬出，仅带走了一些不笨重的大件物品，只使用了几辆黄包车进行搬运。他的家具自此留了下来。

陆克明与我们有姻亲关系。他是苏州人，约30岁，此前在中国邮局工作，月薪约70或80元。

他搬走后，有访客前来询问他的下落。我们也收到类似查询的电话留言。除了知道他住在法租界某处外，我们不知道他的确切地址。以上属实。

签名：顾明滋 ( )

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
REPORT OF POLICE INVESTIGATIONS.

The following is the statement of KOO MING HAU, age 20.
native of Woosung taken by Mr. Soong. (D.S.I.)
at C.I. on the 2.8.38. translated
and interpreted by Clerk Yao.

My name is Koo Ming Hau, aged 20 years, native of Woosung,
S/Student, and residing at 176/5 Chunking Road.
Prior to the outbreak of hostilities, the Koo Family,
to which I belong, lived at House 199 Tai Hsing Road, Woosung.
We used to operate fish hongs as our profession. At that time
I was studying at the Mah Lung Middle School, off Chaufoong
Road.
On the outbreak of hostilities on the 13.8.37, we all
moved from Woosung to take refuge at our relative, Loh Kuh
Ming's residence, situated at House 5, Lane 176, Chunking
Road. (Loh is related to the Koo Family by marriage). The
Koo Family, which moved into Loh's house, consists of seven
persons, i.e. my uncle and aunt, cousin Koo Ming Sz, Brother
Koo Ming Tsung, sister Ming Rien, maid Loh Wong Sz and myself.
The hostilities discontinued my studies, as my school
was situated in the War zone.
Sometime during January, 1938, without informing us
beforehand, Loh Kuh Ming suddenly moved to French Town. We
were rejoiced over his removal as it would save us the trouble
of seeking additional rooms elsewhere for the accomodation of
our family.
Consequently, we approached Loh with the request that we
be allowed to formally continue the tenancy of the premises
on the former's removal there-from, which was agreed to, and
on the completion of all formalities, Koo's household moved out.
We only know that Koo moved to French Town, but do not know
the exact, address. Probably, it was Loh's intention not to

警务调查报告。

以下为顾明浩（KOO MING HAU），20岁，吴淞人，由宋先生（副督察长）于1938年8月2日在刑事调查科讯问，并由姚职员翻译的供词：

我叫顾明浩，现年20岁，吴淞人，学生，居住于重庆路176号5号。
在战事爆发前，我所属的顾家居住在吴淞泰兴路199号。我们以经营鱼行为业。当时我就读于兆丰路附近的麦伦中学。
1937年8月13日战事爆发后，我们全家从吴淞搬至亲戚陆克明位于重庆路176弄5号的住所避难。（陆克明与顾家有姻亲关系）。搬入陆克明家的顾家成员共七人，即我的叔父和婶母、堂兄顾明滋、兄弟顾明宗、姐妹明仁（音译）、女佣陆王氏（音译）以及我自己。
由于学校位于战区，战事导致我中断了学业。
1938年1月某时，陆克明在未事先通知我们的情况下，突然搬往法租界。我们对他的搬离感到高兴，因为这省去了我们为安置家人而在别处寻找额外房间的麻烦。
因此，我们向陆克明提出请求，希望在他搬离后允许我们正式继续租赁该房屋，他同意了。在完成所有手续后，顾家搬出。
我们只知道陆克明搬到了法租界，但不知道确切地址。可能陆克明有意不

On numerous occasions after his removal, Loh's friends
called at our place, asking for information regarding Loh's

REPORT
Date August 2, 19 38.
Subject ASSISTANCE TO JAPANESE MILITARY POLICE.

Made by D.S.I. PRYDE Forwarded by D.I. GLOVER.

Sir,

On the afternoon of 1.8.38, D.S. Mitsushima of the S.P.O. reported that Sgt.Major Katoda of the Japanese Military Police had requested assistance to visit Lane 176, House 5, Connaught Road, at 5:30 a.m. 2.8.38 to endeavour to arrest one, named LOH KUH MING (陸克明), a member of a mobile unit, who is suspected of being concerned in terrorist acts on 7.7.38.

Assistance was rendered by D.S.I.'s Pryde, Soong Ping Tsung of C.B.H.Q.(C.I.) and D.S.Taylor and C.D.S.121 of Chengtu Road Station, and the given address visited at 6 a.m. 2.8.38.

It was found that this house is now occupied by a family named KOO (顧) and a doctor named KAU TSUNG PONG (高振邦)

Loh Kuh Ming (the wanted man) was previously the chief tenant of this house and is related by marriage to the Koo family.

Koo Tai Shao (顧太紹), the head of the Koo family, was previously the master of fish hong at Woosung and had a sub-office in Nantao. When the hostilities commenced, he removed to the Settlement and obtained accomodation with his relation, Loh Kuh Ming. Loh Kuh Ming at that time was an employee of the Chinese Post Office at North Szechuen Road.

Koo Tai Shao's son, named Koo Ming Ts (顧明滋) and his nephew, named Koo Ming Hau (顧明浩), both of whom live at this address, state that Loh Kuh Ming left this address secretly in January, 1938, and removed to the French Concession, address unknown. He was accompanied by his two wives and five children when he removed, but left his furniture at 176/5 Changking Road.

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE SPECIAL BRANCH 11 2 8 38）

中央捕房总部，1938年8月
报告
日期：1938年8月2日。
事由：协助日本宪兵队。

由副督察长 PRYDE 呈报，经督察长 GLOVER 转呈。

先生：

1938年8月1日下午，特别办事处（S.P.O.）的三岛警部补（D.S. Mitsushima）报告称，日本宪兵队的加藤军曹长（Sgt.Major Katoda）请求协助，拟于1938年8月2日凌晨5:30前往康纳路（Connaught Road）176弄5号，试图逮捕一名名为陆克明（LOH KUH MING）的男子，此人为流动小组成员，涉嫌参与1938年7月7日的恐怖活动。

中央捕房总部（刑事调查科）的副督察长 Pryde、宋秉宗（Soong Ping Tsung），以及成都路捕房的副督察长 Taylor 和华籍巡长121号提供了协助，并于1938年8月2日上午6时访问了指定地址。

发现该房屋现由一户姓顾（KOO）的人家和一位名为高振邦（KAU TSUNG PONG）的医生居住。

陆克明（通缉犯）此前是该房屋的主租户，并与顾家有姻亲关系。

顾太绍（Koo Tai Shao），顾家家主，此前是吴淞的鱼行老板，并在南市设有分号。战事开始时，他搬入租界，在其亲戚陆克明处获得住宿。当时陆克明是北四川路中国邮局的雇员。

顾太绍之子顾明滋（Koo Ming Ts）及其侄子顾明浩（Koo Ming Hau）均居住于此地址，他们陈述称陆克明于1938年1月秘密离开此地址，搬往法租界，地址不详。他搬走时由其两位妻子和五个孩子陪同，但将家具留在了重庆路176号5号。

（印章：上海公共租界工部局警务处特科 1938年2月11日 [注：原文印章日期似有误或为归档章，依原文译出]）
（批注：S.I / R / 8月7日）

RECORD OF INVESTIGATION.
Assistance to Crime Branch Headquarters Staff and Japanese Military Authorities.
Previous arrangements having been made with the Senior Detective; at 5.45a.m. 2-8-38, D.S.I. Pryde (C.1) D.S. Mitrishima (S.P.C.) S.I. Soong Ping Tsung, C.D.S.'s 115 and 304 (C.1) came to the station and requested assistance to visit House 5, Lane 176 Chungking Road on behalf of the Japanese Military Authorities represented by Sgt. Maj. Katoda, Sgt. Tsujita, and Sgt. Ikeda of the Japanese Military Police (All in plain clothes), to arrest one named Loh Kuh Ming (陸克明) suspected to be leader of a mobile unit in Pootung and concerned in terroristic activities on the anniversary of the Lukmochiao Incident on 7-7-38.
D.S. Taylor and C.D.S. 121 accompanied the aforementioned parties to the above address, where it was learned that the wanted man, Loh Kuh Ming had removed from this address in October 1937 and his present whereabouts were unknown. He had turned over the chief-tenancy of the house to Koo Dai Tso (顧开棠), 63, Woosung, retired fish broker, who resided in the house with his family consisting of wife, 3 nephews, and 2 nephews' wives, and 2 nieces. The guest room being sub-let to a native style doctor Koh Taun Heng (高振邦)

经与高级侦探事先安排，1938年8月2日上午5:45，侦探副督察 Pryde（C.1组）、侦探 Mitrishima（特别股）、警员宋秉忠，以及刑事侦缉警员115号和304号（C.1组）来到捕房，请求协助代表日本军方的日本宪兵队军曹 Katoda、军曹 Tsujita 和军曹 Ikeda（均着便衣），前往重庆路176弄5号，逮捕一名名为陆克明（Loh Kuh Ming）的男子，该人涉嫌为浦东某流动小队队长，并参与1938年7月7日卢沟桥事变周年纪念日的恐怖活动。

侦探 Taylor 和刑事侦缉警员121号陪同上述人员前往上述地址，得知被通缉者陆克明已于1937年10月搬离该址，目前下落不明。他已将房屋的主租赁权转交给顾开棠（Koo Dai Tso），63岁，吴淞人，退休鱼行经纪人，他与家人居住在该屋内，家庭成员包括妻子、3个侄子、2个侄媳和2个侄女。客房转租给一位中式医生高振邦（Koh Taun Heng）。
